sources.locator: Official ASNEF.FIN.DAT; complete transient scan of 9,200,232 fixed-width records; one strict private-identifier and name match; identifier withheld
sources.collection_name: World War II Army Enlistment Records
sources.rights_notes: No raw row or full private identifier is retained. David M Davis has the sole exact identifier-and-name match. Curtis C Davis's short private value is ineligible for strict comparison, and all name-only Army rows remain unassigned. The incomplete Army file is not a comprehensive OSS, officer, Navy, Marine Corps, civilian, WAC, Coast Guard, or foreign roster; a non-hit is not negative proof. David M Davis's occupation value 944 is not interpreted because the official table does not define 9-44.

sources.title: World War II Army Enlistment Records: Code Lists
sources.repository_publisher: National Archives at College Park - Electronic Records
sources.locator: Code No. 30, Civilian Occupations, PDF physical page 174; transportation entry 5, 7-44 visually and textually checked
sources.collection_name: World War II Army Enlistment Records technical documentation
sources.rights_notes: The official table defines 5-44 and 7-44 as railroad switchmen but does not define 9-44. The raw Army value 944 is therefore left uninterpreted and is not silently converted to a different listed skill-level code.

claims.claim_text: The OSS index and Army merged file identify the same David M Davis.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The private identifier and exact full name agree across the two official NARA records.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by the exact private identifier and full-name agreement.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army row records entry on December 15, 1942, as private.
claims.match_notes: The private value is withheld publicly. Thirteen other exact-name Army rows have different identifiers. Occupation value 944 is not published because the official code table defines 5-44 and 7-44 but not 9-44.
